policy: deterministic policy; action noise 0 unless the variant flag --action-noise-std is given (reported per result)
foot_friction: training DR: foot friction 0.3-1.2 per reset, torso COM offset at startup, encoder bias per reset (Cuboi env defaults)
nominal_env: not nominal: training-distribution observation noise, reset noise and domain randomisation are ON; env seed given by --seed (default 0)
unit: fixed 10 s windows (500 control steps) tiled from each clip start, non-overlapping, last partial window dropped; each window starts from the reference state at its first frame
completed: window reaches its 500th step without physical termination
status: frozen definition; implementation pending (needed before tier C acceptance)

extra_metrics.whole_body: mean tracked-body position error (m) over the 14 TRACKED_BODIES, world frame and root-relative
extra_metrics.aggregation: per clip: mean over alive steps and value at fixed times; alive-only means reported together with executed_steps to expose survival bias

purpose: same clips and denominator as the nominal protocol, under the perturbations the policy was trained with; answers how much of the nominal score survives noise
